units.source_text: 这个姓鹤川的少年，是昨晚经人介绍才认识的。

en.t: I had only met this boy named Tsurukawa the night before, through someone else's introduction.

units.source_text: 鹤川家在东京近郊的祖福寺里，家里送了很多学习费、零用费和粮食等物。

en.t: The Tsurukawa family lived at Sofukuji Temple near Tokyo, and his family sent him plenty of tuition money, pocket money, food, and other supplies.

units.source_text: 只是为了让他体验弟子的学习生活，家里才通过住持将他托付给金阁寺。

en.t: Simply so that he could experience the study life of a disciple, his family had entrusted him to Kinkakuji through the head priest.

units.source_text: 他暑期回乡省亲，是昨晚提前返回寺庙来的。

en.t: He had gone home during the summer vacation to visit his family, and had returned to the temple early the previous night.

units.source_text: 站在池畔操着东京口音说话的鹤川从秋天起成了我在临济学院中学的同班同学。

en.t: Tsurukawa, who stood by the pond speaking with a Tokyo accent, became my classmate at Rinzai Academy Middle School from that autumn.

units.source_text: 从昨晚起，他那伶俐的口齿，快活的谈吐，就已使我恐惧了。

en.t: Since the night before, his quick tongue and cheerful way of speaking had already begun to frighten me.
